## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing outcome.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the constitution in `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.
- [ ] Tests were written first and pass.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, `client.rest`, dependency caches, or machine-local tool state are staged.
- [ ] Any new package was approved and recorded in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] `npm run verify:ignore` passes if ignore rules changed.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when setup or dependencies change.
